name: Amir Naltheri
source: Amir's a beautiful socialite who does escort work with the global elite while secretly building up resources and contacts for an elaborate revenge plot.  In his desperation to bring his dead husband's killer to justice, Amir takes a deal that turns him into a demonic succubus with mind melting powers.  Underneath his perfectly maintained mask, however, is a passionate soul trying to survive on his own.
